Introduced by HP for students, the '''HP&nbsp;10s''' (F2214A) is a scientific calculator with more than 240 built-in functions, with 2 lines x 10 digits [[LCD]]. It is permitted to use on [[SAT]] and [[ACT (test)|ACT]] tests.<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://h41111.www4.hp.com/calculators/uk/en/scientific/10s/index.html | title=HP calculators &#124; HP® United Kingdom}}</ref>

It has a standard scientific layout and function set that very closely correlates with the [[Casio]] fx-85MS, allowing for calculations to be done in a short time.

{{anchor|10s+}}The 10s was replaced by the '''HP&nbsp;10s+''' (NW276AA).

{{anchor|10sII}}In 2022, [[Moravia Consulting spol.&nbsp;s&nbsp;r.o.]] launched the '''HP&nbsp;10sII''' for the Australian market.
